message:
Prepare the update. Reply with {"messages": [...], "revised_schedule": [...], "volunteer_tasks": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill. Do NOT create files: Ripple builds the .ics and .csv itself.
- One message per affected group (effect "inform", "resize" or the disruption origin); "group" = the group id. Say only what changed for that group. status "draft".
- "to": the address of a single person (see the attached people.csv), otherwise a short description like "40 workshop participants".
- "actions": the recovery checklist for the organizer team, 3 to 8 items, most urgent first: {"title", "description", "owner" (a role or team named in the files, e.g. "Volunteer lead", "Organizer", "Caterer"), "deadline" (a time or day taken from the plan, never invented), "priority" ("high"|"medium"|"low")}. Include confirming every item of the chosen option's "to_confirm" list.
- "revised_schedule": every schedule item or commitment whose time or place changes: {"id": node id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM", "place": "..."}. Empty list if nothing moves.

messages.body: Hello, the main hall for the event on 21 November 2026 has been cancelled by the organizer's venue. The event is moving to the Maison de la Chimie – amphitheatre, 28 rue Saint-Dominique, Paris 7e (the exact room is being confirmed). Your session times stay the same, but the opening is 20 minutes later at 09:00 and the awards start at 16:30. Please allow about 20 extra minutes for travel to the new address. More details will follow once the organizer confirms.

load_skill: Load skill into the sandbox
The skill references a reference.md for the exact shape. Let me read it.

Key points from the contract: the user says not to create files, so I'll omit `files`. Per the user's request, the actions list goes into the output too. Messages must be one per affected group, with `"to"` a single person's address from people.csv or a short description otherwise. The contract's coordinator shape doesn't have an `actions` field, but the user explicitly requested it, so I'll include it.

Notes on the data:
- `grp_speaker_2` and `grp_speaker_3` are single persons, so their `to` will be their email. `grp_speakers` is a group of 3, so "to" is a description.
- `grp_attendees` (200) is a description. `grp_workshop_participants` (40) is a description.
- `grp_caterer` is "Green Fork Catering" — the contract file isn't uploaded, so I have no email; I'll use a description.
- `grp_volunteers` (12): description.
- Hall capacity mismatch: venue_main_hall capacity is 220, but scenario C's capacity is 516 with attendees 200. The "to_confirm" list says which amphitheatre is unclear, so I must not claim availability.
- Revised schedule: items whose time/place changes: opening? Times unchanged, so no. Affected items with "moved" effect were listed by the backend, but I should only include items whose time or place actually changes per `changes`. Changes: av_setup (07:30, Maison de la Chimie), volunteer_meetup (07:15, Maison de la Chimie), catering_delivery (location), workshop_s2 (location), awards (16:30–17:00 — unchanged times as given in the set, so it's listed in changes; I'll include it with its values), venue_main_hall replaced. Lunch, round_1, round_2, opening have no change in `changes` — they're not in the scenario's changes, so I'll leave them out.
- Catering delivery: no time given in the set, so keep 12:00 as the existing time; place is Maison de la Chimie.

Actions: must include confirming each to_confirm item (7 items). Limit is 3 to 8 items. I'll combine some items to fit within 8. Deadlines must come from the plan; the only times available are 07:15, 07:30, 07:45, 12:00, 16:30, 10:00, 2026-11-21. I'll use the event date or the plan times.

Volunteer tasks: volunteer meetup moves to 07:15 at Maison de la Chimie; the volunteer lead should inform the 12 volunteers.

Now the messages. Per the contract, each message needs `group`, `to`, `channel`, `subject`, `body`, `status`.
